map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-14 03:01): mail returned 919 (state 903); early in person 8,617 (state 8,510). Clermont (as of 2026-10-14 20:32): mail returned 2,420 (state 913); early in person 4,512 (state 3,899). Crawford (as of 2026-10-14 16:05): mail returned 374 (state 237); early in person 940 (state 764). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-14 17:01): mail returned 18,472 (state 14,760); early in person 11,017 (state 9,644). Franklin (as of 2026-10-14 00:12): early in person 19,383 (state 19,131); ballots sent 74,904 (state 74,051). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-13 19:07): early in person 14,582 (state 14,394). Henry (as of 2026-10-14 16:25): early in person 868 (state 756). Morrow (as of 2026-10-14 16:09): mail returned 277 (state 225); early in person 905 (state 771). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-14 08:17): mail returned 1,278 (state 1,243); early in person 4,316 (state 4,315).
